subject: Agriculture
title: Weather Prediction for Farmers
description: One-minute skill: Weather Prediction for Farmers.

hook.text: A single hailstorm can destroy an entire season's crop in minutes. Precise weather forecasts are worth millions.

buildup.text: Traditional farming relied on folk wisdom and seasonal patterns. Climate change has made old patterns unreliable.

discovery.text: AI weather models now provide hyper-local forecasts—field-level predictions with hourly granularity up to 14 days ahead.

twist.text: Weather index insurance pays farmers when satellites detect drought—no inspector needed. It's transforming risk management.

climax.text: In Kenya, weather-indexed crop insurance via mobile money reaches farmers traditional insurers never could.

punchline.text: You can't control the weather. But knowing it's coming changes everything.

quiz.question: How does weather index insurance differ from traditional crop insurance?
options: It pays automatically based on satellite-detected weather events—no inspector needed
